scenario.irule:
when CLIENT_ACCEPTED { set ::ports [list [SCTP::client_port] [SCTP::server_port] [SCTP::local_port] [SCTP::remote_port] [SCTP::local_port clientside] [SCTP::remote_port serverside]]; set ::timers [list [SCTP::rto_initial] [SCTP::rto_max] [SCTP::rto_min] [SCTP::sack_timeout]]; set ::mss [SCTP::mss]; SCTP::ppi 3; SCTP::collect 4 }
when CLIENT_DATA { set ::before [list [SCTP::payload] [SCTP::payload length] [SCTP::payload 2]]; SCTP::payload replace 0 4 PONG; SCTP::respond reply 0 3; set ::after [SCTP::payload]; SCTP::release 0; log local0. "ports=$::ports timers=$::timers mss=$::mss ppi=[SCTP::ppi] before=$::before after=$::after" }
